items.headline: Which one-loss SEC teams are ready to prove they are for real?
items.description: SEC Network's Chris Doering and Benjamin Watson highlight the teams sitting atop the conference standings and pick who they trust to finish at the top.

items.headline: Rowe takes us inside Texas minds, shares Chambliss' reaction
items.description: ESPN's Holly Rowe explores Arch Manning's perspective, Steve Sarkisian's take on his recent performances and shares Ole Miss QB Trinidad Chambliss' unexpected reaction.

items.headline: Tebow analyzes impact of star quarterbacks Manning and Chambliss
items.description: SEC Network's Tim Tebow joins The Paul Finebaum Show to discuss how Arch Manning and the Texas offense can get back on track and Trinidad Chambliss' ability to raise Ole Miss' ceiling.

items.headline: ESPN's Taylor Davis previews UK vs. Vandy, analyzes Ole Miss upset
items.description: Davis dives into Vanderbilt's journey to find its rhythm while discussing No. 15 Kentucky's confidence going into Week 8, and dissects Ole Miss' dominant upset over Mizzou.

items.headline: Fowler describes Manning's urgency ahead of Texas vs. Ole Miss
items.description: ESPN's Chris Fowler joins The Paul Finebaum Show to discuss Arch Manning's added sense of urgency as the No. 19 Longhorns prepare to face the No. 7 Rebels.

items.headline: Top 25 betting lines: Texas favored vs. Ole Miss, Utah the fave vs. Houston
items.description: This week's odds and FPI predictions for Texas-Ole Miss, Utah-Houston and every top 25 matchup.
